translation: Greatly cold, not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat phlegm-heat, heat within the stomach, acute twisting pain of the lower abdomen, digesting grain, and benefiting the small intestine; women's blood stoppage (血閉), dripping discharge (淋露), down-flowing blood, and children's abdominal pain. One name is 空腸, one name is 內虛, one name is 黃文, one name is 經 [芩].
